name: Defines Job
description: A workflow file declares a job. The declaration side of the pipeline: what a job is permitted to do is written here, while what it did is on the github_actions_job it instantiates.

job_key.description: The job's YAML key — its identity within the file, and what `needs:` refers to.

order.description: Position of the job in the file, so the declaration can be rendered in written order rather than alphabetically.
